primary_inference: Exclude all 41 final AVOIDABLE_IDENTITY_CUE prompts from primary inferential summaries.
sensitivity_analysis: Retain the 41 prompts unchanged as one clearly preregistered sensitivity-only stratum and report its results separately from the primary set.
frozen_prompt_policy: Do not rewrite, replace, or silently relabel any of the frozen 1,077 prompts.
rationale: Avoidable identity wording can change routing difficulty and therefore threatens comparability in primary inference. Preserving the frozen prompts maintains provenance, while a separately declared sensitivity stratum makes the effect inspectable without contaminating the primary estimand.
claims_boundary: This is a prospective analysis-design recommendation and does not create a quality pass or an experiment result.
